items.text: Use Premium and Standard tiers for staging slots and automated backups. Align your backup retention period with disaster recovery needs.
items.graph: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' | extend compliant = (sku.tier == 'Premium' or sku.tier == 'Standard') | distinct id,compliant

items.text: Implement health checks to monitor and detect issues with App Service instances. Health checks enable automatic instance replacement on failure.
items.graph: appserviceresources  | where type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites/config' | extend compliant = (properties.HealthCheckPath != '') | distinct id,compliant

items.text: Set minimum TLS policy to 1.2 or higher, preferably 1.3, in App Service configuration.
items.graph: appserviceresources | where type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites/config' | extend compliant = (properties.MinTlsVersion>=1.2) | distinct id,compliant

items.text: Use HTTPS only and consider enabling HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS).
items.graph: where (type=='microsoft.web/sites' and (kind == 'app' or kind == 'app,linux' )) | extend compliant = (properties.httpsOnly==true) | distinct id,compliant

items.text: Turn off remote debugging in production environments.
items.graph: appserviceresources | where type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites/config' | extend compliant = (properties.RemoteDebuggingEnabled == false) | distinct id,compliant
